description: Rank currencies by how strongly they revert to their historical mean, using a composite 0–100 score (crossing frequency + reversion half-life), plus current deviation and half-life in days. Use for questions like "does EUR snap back to its average". Provide `currencies` to score specific codes, or omit to rank the liquid set. Use `analyze_history` for raw change and `analyze_volatility` for dispersion. Defaults: roughly a 2-year window, `base` USD, `limit` 10. Returns `{ base, from, to, results[] }`; `score` and `halfLifeDays` are null when there is not enough reverting data. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

base.description: Base currency to measure against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

currencies.description: Comma-separated currencies to score, e.g. EUR,GBP. OMIT to rank the liquid set.

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to ~2 years before `to`.

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

name: analyze_mean_reversion
title: Mean-reversion analysis
